title: Public Administration in Nepal
notes:
Public Administration Basics

Public administration is the implementation of government policy and the management of public programs. In Nepal it operates under the Civil Service Act, 2049 (1992) and the Local Government Operation Act, 2074.

Civil Service Structure

  • Post classes: Gazetted (officer level) and Non-Gazetted (staff level).
  • Gazetted levels: 1st class (Secretary), 2nd class (Joint Secretary), 3rd class (Under Secretary).
  • Non-Gazetted: officers (1st/2nd/3rd class) and staff (Khurda, etc.).

Key Concepts

  • Good governance: participation, rule of law, transparency, responsiveness, accountability, effectiveness.
  • Decentralization: transfer of authority and functions from the center to provincial and local governments.
